trader-desk.title: Trader desk
trader-desk.summary: Own Gotchi-Trader paper desk health, cycle decisions and PnL reporting.
trader-desk.autonomy: Wakes every 30 minutes and runs a full cycle: desk health, meta-model and strategy signals, news regime, decisions clipped by explicit risk rules, then verification by a persistent interactive Claude session in a terminal visible on the desktop (PASS/CONCERN/FAIL). Paper desk: real execution requires TRADER_LIVE=1 plus a PASS verdict plus no risk breach, and no order router is wired, so the live branch refuses to fake a fill. Risk rules: min score 0.6, min cross-strategy breadth 0.5, 5000 USDC per position, 15000 USDC per cycle, sizes halved in risk-off, and no ETH/BTC adds while the desk concentration warning is live. Intended waker is cron402 via scripts/trader-webhook.mjs (:8792); until the Cloudflare ingress exists the schedule runs from config/launchagents/com.gotchibot.trader-cycle.plist.

infra-monitor.title: Infra home monitor
infra-monitor.summary: Own iMac Docker/subgraph/tunnel health; watch continuously and verify with the Claude CLI.
infra-monitor.autonomy: Resident watcher in tmux gotchibot:infrawatch ticks every 60s and reports transitions, not steady state. Every 30 ticks and on every transition it asks a persistent interactive Claude CLI session, in tmux window gotchibot:claude-verify, for an independent verdict; because that session keeps context it can say what changed since the last check. A disagreement between Claude and the probes is treated as an incident. The verify session runs in ~/Dev/gotchibot-infra-verify, outside the GotchiBot repo, so it does not inherit the repo CLAUDE.md hub-proxy role and block on a scope-check prompt. Only the watched aarcade/envio containers gate the docker check. On degrade follow infra-recover (paper-only).

selfServe: Docker autostart: ~/Library/Group Containers/group.com.docker/settings-store.json -> "AutoStart": true (a file, not a GUI-only checkbox)
Container never returns after a reboot: docker update --restart unless-stopped <container>
docker restart succeeds but StartedAt does not move: docker kill then docker start; the cure is recreating with --init
abra dies with Cannot find package ...abracadabra/dist/index.js: cd ~/Dev/abracadabra && npm install --omit=dev (lockfile restore, allowed)
needsUser: sudo shutdown -r now — no NOPASSWD rule on the iMac, so no agent can reboot the host; reassigning to another hero hits the same wall
anything needing the login keychain non-interactively (docker credential helper, abra on the iMac over SSH)
hostLevel.rule: Before telling the user something is human-only, check whether it is a config file you can edit. Report what you did, the one thing left, and the literal command.

aarcade-comms-handler.title: Aarcade daily comms
aarcade-comms-handler.summary: Own newsfeed + tweet-draft pipeline (Commsies on iMac; tweets stay approve-gated).
aarcade-comms-handler.autonomy: On schedule/cron (daily) and when asked: poll /communications-agent/queue, run pending repos, report sessions/comms-logs; never post to X; never print secrets.
